Subject: Everholt Hotel Group Submission - Referral Required

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Everholt Hotel Group. I've reviewed the materials and everything looks complete—appreciate the thorough package!

However, hotel risks require referral to our senior underwriting team for approval before I can provide a quote. This is due to the specialized nature of hospitality exposures.

Given the referral timeline, I'd recommend also reaching out to specialty markets that focus on hospitality risks to ensure your client has competitive options.

I'm happy to expedite the referral on our end if you'd like to proceed with us as well. Just let me know how you'd like to move forward.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
